tasks.name: מיון עולה
tasks.note: Sorts the list in ascending order.

tasks.name: היפוך
tasks.note: Reverses the order of the list.

tasks.name: בלי שני הראשונים
tasks.note: Drops the first two elements by position (empty if fewer than three).

tasks.name: רק מעל 11
tasks.note: Keeps elements greater than 11 (i.e. 12..15) in original order.

tasks.name: שלושת הקטנים
tasks.note: Sorts ascending and keeps the first three (the three smallest).

tasks.name: אי-זוגיים מהגדול
tasks.note: Keeps odd elements and sorts them in descending order.

tasks.name: האמצע הפוך
tasks.note: Drops the first and last elements and reverses what remains.

tasks.name: רק 9, 12, 14
tasks.note: Keeps only members of the fixed set {9,12,14}, preserving order.

tasks.name: זוגיים קודם
tasks.note: Stable partition: even elements first, then odd ones, each in original order.

tasks.name: בלי שני הקטנים, מהגדול
tasks.note: Three steps: sort ascending, drop the two smallest, then reverse.

tasks.name: גדולים מהראשון
tasks.note: Keeps elements greater than the first element (the comparison value comes from the list itself).

tasks.name: זוגיים עד האי-זוגי
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(x%2===1) break; r.push(x); } return r; }
tasks.note: Take-while loop: keeps the leading run of even elements, stopping at the first odd one.
